test.create_query: CREATE TABLE final_non_intersecting_prewhere ( key UInt64, ver UInt64, selector UInt32, c1 String, c2 String, c3 String, c4 String, c5 UInt64, c6 UInt64, c7 UInt64, c8 UInt64, c9 Float64, c10 Float64, c11 Float64, c12 Float64, c13 LowCardinality(String), c14 LowCardinality(String), c15 DateTime, c16 DateTime ) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(ver) ORDER BY key
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO final_non_intersecting_prewhere SELECT number, 1, cityHash64(number) % 1000, toString(number), toString(number * 3), toString(number * 7), toString(number * 11), number * 2, number * 5, number * 13, number * 17, number / 3, number / 7, number / 11, number / 13, toString(number % 100), toString(number % 1000), toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') + number, toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') - number FROM numbers(10000000)

INSERT INTO final_non_intersecting_prewhere SELECT 5000000 + number, 2, cityHash64(number) % 1000, 'new', 'new', 'new', 'new', number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, 'new', 'new', toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00'), toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') FROM numbers(10000)

INSERT INTO final_non_intersecting_prewhere SELECT 9990000 + number, 3, cityHash64(number) % 1000, 'new', 'new', 'new', 'new', number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number, 'new', 'new', toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00'), toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') FROM numbers(100000)
